Trend: the engineer's path

Today the page is the title (Engineering · Trend, no ?), a grey band and a chart that fills the rest of the screen. The band holds the loop search field, From and To date fields (always shown; empty "dd/mm/yyyy --:-- --" while live), Apply window, and Open loop ↗ at its far end. Once a window is applied, Apply window stays highlighted, Live › and PINNED WINDOW join it, and Open loop ↗ drops to a second row at 1440 px. The chart has the legend above the plot (PV 77.87 × · SP 77.78 × · OP 26.59 ×: the value at the cursor, a click hides a pen, × removes it), the plot (one axis, no units), the slider, and under it a time bar: start clock, 15m 1h 8h 1d 1w, ◀ ⏸ ▶▶ Now, end clock, Zoom area · Undo · Reset, and the mode in green capitals (LIVE, PAUSED, HISTORICAL, NO NEW SAMPLES). With a window applied the time bar goes and a zoom bar takes its place: start clock, Zoom area · Undo · Reset, end clock. There is no dialog, no export and no saved view; the address carries loop, roles, tags, range, from and to. On a fixed window the period is said three times (the inputs, the two clocks, PINNED WINDOW) in two time zones: the inputs read 10:45 → 22:45 (the site zone, UTC), the chart 14:45 → 02:45 (the browser's). Proposed: the Historical pattern. One band card (loop · range · ‹ dates › · Pause · Now … Loop Explorer ↗), one head row over the chart (legend … Zoom area · Undo · Reset), the plot exactly as today, and a foot strip that says the state and the zone once.

Pick the loop

Which loop do I want to see?
  • The search field first in the band: one list, flat by tag, in the header scope (CHG-160, as today)
  • From Historical (Open in Trend ↗), Loop Explorer (Trend ↗, Signals), Window Inspector (Trend ↗) or the Designer: the loop, its roles and the period come with the link
  • A link with tags: the field reads "4 tags from a link" (Q8)

Choose the period

Over what time?
  • Range drop-down named by its options: 15m · 1h · 8h · 24h · 7d (Q2) · Custom
  • ‹ › move half a period, as today; › stops at now; a fixed period steps too (Q3)
  • Pause (Resume) while live; Now back to live
  • Custom, or a click on the dates: From · To · Apply under the band

Read the trend

What did the signals do?
  • Legend: PV, SP, OP, VP with the value at the cursor (the latest without one) and its unit (Q1)
  • A click hides a pen, × removes it, Signals ▾ brings it back (Q5)
  • The cursor and its tooltip stay where the pointer rests (bug 6); a double-click clears it

Look closer

What happened here?
  • Zoom area · Undo · Reset at the end of the head row, live or fixed
  • The slider, the wheel and drag-to-pan as today
  • Live and zoomed: "Zoomed · Reset to follow live" in the foot

Know what is on screen

Is it live, and in which zone?
  • Foot: ● Live · ◐ No new samples · ‖ Paused · ○ Fixed period
  • "times in UTC" once; every time on the page in the site zone; ticks "11:00", a new day "5 Nov" (Q10)
  • A pen not read: "◐ OP not read · the values shown may be incomplete"

Go on

Where next?
  • Loop Explorer ↗ (outlined): the loop's summary, gates and signals
  • Historical ↗ (Q6): the KPI overlay, the results and Export on the same period
  • The address reopens what is drawn (Q4)

What stays exactly

The address and access/trend, historian.view; the loop field with analytics.view (without it: the band without the field, the rest the same); ?loop=, ?roles=, ?tags= (tags win), ?range=, ?from=/?to=; the sidebar link keeps the plant scope and the loop
The trendThe chart engine as is: pen colours from --signal-pv/sp/op/vp (tag pens the chart palette), SP dashed, one axis per unit when units differ, the slider, wheel zoom and drag-to-pan, Zoom area · Undo · Reset ("Zoom area · on", Escape leaves), the cursor kept after the pointer leaves, double-click clears it
The legendSwatch, name, value at the cursor (latest without one, two decimals, "--" with none), × removes (the last one leaves the chart empty, roles=none), a click hides and strikes through; hover shows the tag's path
DataHistory per pen sized to the plot width, gaps dropped (never zero); live tail every 2 s while live and not zooming; a pen that fails is named; MODE is not trended
Ranges and steps15m (default), 1h, 8h, 24 h, 7 d; a step moves half the range; Pause freezes the window end; Now returns to live and resets the zoom; a new range resets the zoom; "No new samples" when the newest sample is older than a tenth of the range (at least 1 min)
CustomFrom and To in the site zone, Apply, the two error lines; a newly fixed window resets the zoom
Loop fieldCHG-160 search field, Retired pill, "… is outside the plant scope in the header. It stays selected until you pick another.", "… is not in the loop registry."; choosing a loop replaces the pens and keeps the period
Sizes32 px band controls (cpm-compact, as Historical); the chart fills the rest of the page; legend and axis type sizes as today

For the owner to decide

  1. Give the chart the loop's units? PV and SP take the registry's pvUnit ("unit not set" when it has none, as Historical), OP and VP "%". The legend then reads "PV 77.87 kg/h", and the chart's own rule (one axis per unit) puts OP on its own axis, as Historical's "PV / SP (kg/h)" and "OP / VP (%)". Today PV 73-79 kg/h and OP 22-38 % share one 20-80 axis with no unit (before-07); with OP missing, PV fills the axis and its cycling reads at once (before-28). This changes what the axes show, which is why it is a question. Only 11 of 243 lab loops have a pvUnit. Recommended: yes. No backend change. Drawn dashed in the legend.
  2. Range words "24h" and "7d" instead of "1d" and "1w"? Historical offers 24h · 7d · 30d · 90d, Loop Explorer 8h · 24h · 7d · 30d. Same spans, words only. Recommended: yes. Drawn in the range list.
  3. ‹ › also step a fixed period? Today a fixed window hides every range and step control; to see the next 12 h you edit both dates or press Live › and start again. Stepping writes the new from/to, half the span at a time, and › stops at now. Recommended: yes. Client side. Drawn (the stepper is active on a fixed period).
  4. The address follows the screen? A range choice writes ?range=, a step writes ?from=/?to=, so Back / Forward and a copied link reopen what is drawn (bug 2). Today the address keeps range=1w while the chart shows 1d. Recommended: yes. Client side. Not drawn.
  5. Signals ▾ in the head row, to bring a removed pen back? PV, SP, OP, VP ticks (VP "unmapped" when the registry has none, as Historical's chip), writing the same roles= the × writes. Today a removed pen comes back only by choosing the same loop again, and the menu calls the page "Any tags on one chart". Adds a control. Recommended: yes. Client side. Drawn dashed.
  6. Historical ↗ in the band, beside Loop Explorer ↗? Same loop and period; Historical already links here with Open in Trend ↗, and it holds the KPI overlay, the results and Export. Adds a link. Recommended: yes. Client side. Drawn dashed.
  7. An export on Trend? None today. A browser-built "Signal samples (CSV)" of what is drawn (nothing sent) would add a capability; Historical's Export already gives the same signals at the loop's sample period for the same range, one click away with question 6. Recommended: no. Not drawn.
  8. Links that carry tags: say so in the band, and name each pen by its loop? A Designer link (or ?loop=FIC10401&tags=…) draws other loops' tags while the band shows FIC10401 and Open loop ↗ opens FIC10401 (before-24). Proposed: the field reads "4 tags from a link" (choosing a loop replaces them, as today), pens read "FIC10302 VP" when the registry knows the tag, else the path's last part as today ("fic10302.vp"); no Loop Explorer ↗. Recommended: yes. Client side. Drawn dashed.
  9. Break the line where nothing was stored? FIC10401 stored nothing from about 5 Nov 08:00 to 6 Nov 07:30; the chart joins the two blocks with a straight line, which reads as data (before-15). Historical leaves the gap empty. This changes how a series is drawn, which the owner keeps; the sample draws today's line. Recommended: yes. Client side. Not drawn.
  10. Ticks without seconds, and a date where a day starts? Today every tick carries seconds ("15:00:00") and never a date, so a 7 d window shows seven "00:00:00" (before-15, before-19) and a 12 h window across midnight cannot say which day. The app already has a tick format that does this (siteAxisTick, cpa/siteTime.ts:76). Recommended: yes. Client side. Drawn on 7 d.
  11. "Select a loop" on the empty page? Today the empty page draws empty axes, the slider and the whole time bar and says nothing (before-01). Historical's words, one line, no sentence. Recommended: yes. Client side. Drawn dashed.

Audit findings

Bugs

  • 1 · One window, two time zones, no zone named. The From / To inputs use the site zone (UTC on the lab: 10:45 → 22:45), the clocks, axis and tooltip the browser's (Asia/Dubai here: 06/11 14:45 → 07/11 02:45). Historical and Loop Explorer say 10:45 → 22:45 for the same window. TrendPage.tsx:33 (toSiteInput) vs TrendCore.tsx:126-128 (display zone, default 'local', timeStore.ts:65). before-07, ref-historical-same-window-viewport.png, facts-main.json "07".
  • 2 · The address does not follow the range. After 1w then 1d the address still reads ?loop=FIC10401 with no range; a ?range=1w link opened while already on Trend draws 8 h, because the range is read only when the chart mounts (TrendCore.tsx:130, TrendPage.tsx:69-72); steps never reach the address. facts-main.json 15-22; explore2 run ("in-page range=1w span h 8").
  • 3 · ▶▶ steps into the future. Three steps forward from 7 d show 11 Nov → 18 Nov, empty, reading HISTORICAL (TrendCore.tsx:302-306, no clamp). before-19.
  • 4 · No units, so one axis for everything. FIC10401's registry has pvUnit kg/h and OP 0-100; the legend shows "PV 77.87 · SP 77.78 · OP 26.59" with no unit and one 20-80 axis. Loop pens carry no unit (loopPens.ts:36-42), the unit is guessed from the measurement name ("pv" → none, trendSupport.ts:57-68), so the one-axis-per-unit rule never fires (TrendCore.tsx:277-279). before-07, before-23, before-28.
  • 5 · A 7 d axis reads "00:00:00" seven times. The axis format has hours, minutes and seconds and no date (trendSupport.ts:80; its comment says "terser when the window is under a day", nothing switches it). before-15, before-19; on 12 h across midnight "00:00:00" has no date (before-07).
  • 6 · The cursor tooltip vanishes. With the pointer held still it shows for about 30 ms and is gone by 630 ms; only the legend keeps following. Each cursor move re-renders and re-applies the whole option (TrendCore.tsx:134-139, 344-348 notMerge). probe-cursor.txt. Its time is a third format, "2026-11-06 20:32:41", in the browser zone.
  • 7 · "NO NEW SAMPLES" in the run colour. Green capitals (Designer.css:2634 var(--ams-run)) on a chart with nothing in it. before-02.
  • 8 · A gap is drawn as data. Empty buckets are dropped before plotting (TrendCore.tsx:202-206), so the line joins 5 Nov 08:00 to 6 Nov 07:30 (before-15). Question 9.
  • 9 · Tags from a link contradict the band. ?loop=FIC10401&tags=…: the band shows FIC10401, the chart FIC10401, FIC10302 and FIC10509 tags, Open loop ↗ opens FIC10401 (TrendPage.tsx:59-67). The same tag is green as a loop pen and red as a tag pen (before-24 vs before-07). Question 8.

Controls that do nothing, unclear or doubled

  • "Live ›" (band, fixed) and "Now" (time bar, live) do the same: back to the live rolling window (TrendPage.tsx:159, TrendTimeBar.tsx:55).
  • "Apply window" stays highlighted once applied (TrendPage.tsx:155), so the applied state looks like a pending action (before-07).
  • While fixed, every range and step control is gone (TrendPage.tsx:194); 8 h after a fixed window needs Live › first (before-07, before-14).
  • Glyph-only buttons: ◀ "Step back", ⏸ "Play/Pause", ▶▶ "Step forward" (TrendTimeBar.tsx:46-50); ▶ (resume) and ▶▶ (step) look alike; ◀ moves half a period, Historical's ‹ a whole one ("One period earlier").
  • From and To always on screen, empty while live (before-02); 12-hour "AM/PM" there, 24-hour everywhere else; the first digit cut at 1440 px (before-07).
  • "Open loop ↗" offered for FIC99999, which is not in the registry (before-26), and for a tags link whose pens are other loops' (before-24).
  • The menu calls the page "Any tags on one chart" (destinations.ts:119), but the page offers only one loop's four roles; other tags come only through a Designer link; a removed pen returns only by choosing the same loop again.
  • The loop list offers 13 loops with no signal tags (EVAPI_…, KDEMO_…) that draw nothing (before-03, before-27).
  • The empty page draws a full chart frame and time bar and says nothing; the code comment says "the band says Choose a loop" (TrendPage.tsx:199), the band says "Search loops" (before-01).

Words and formats

  • Four time formats on one screen: clocks "06/11, 14:45:00", ticks "15:00:00", tooltip "2026-11-06 20:32:41", inputs "06/11/2026 10:45 AM"; none is "6 Nov 14:45"; the zone is never named.
  • Capitals: PINNED WINDOW, NO NEW SAMPLES, HISTORICAL, PAUSED, LIVE.
  • "1 pen(s) failed to load: OP - values shown may be incomplete" (TrendCore.tsx:340-341; before-28); "live · viewport held while zoomed, Reset to follow" (ChartZoomBar.tsx:41; before-17).
  • "1d" / "1w" here, "24h" / "7d" on Historical and Loop Explorer; "Open loop ↗" here, "Loop Explorer ↗" on Historical.
  • The legend's hover text is the full path: "hdpe/section_100/u1001_polymerization_reactor_1/fic10302.pv — click to hide" (TrendLegend.tsx:31; titles-pinned.json).
  • Tag pens are named by the path's end in lower case ("fic10302.vp", before-25).

Repeated

  • A fixed window is said three times: the inputs, the two clocks of the zoom bar, PINNED WINDOW; live, the two clocks repeat the axis's ends.
  • "Loop not found" in the chart under "FIC99999 is not in the loop registry." in the band (TrendPage.tsx:185, LoopBand.tsx:46; before-26).
  • Live › and Now.

Found on the way, not part of this proposal

  • FIC10401's PV is read from another historian series than its SP and OP: the resolver answers root.hdpe.section_600.u6002_….fic10401.pv (provenance "fallback") for PV and root.hdpev2.cpm.FIC10401.sp / .op (asset model) for SP and OP (resolve.json).
  • In the preview, Historical finds no PV / SP / OP for FIC10401 on 6 Nov 10:45 → 22:45 while Trend draws 1,168 points per pen for the same window: two data paths (the CPM series vs the binding resolver); the preview's historian prefix is the known artefact (ref-historical-same-window-viewport.png).
  • On the lab the newest FIC10401 sample is 7 Nov 11:51 UTC; every loop reads NO NEW SAMPLES live, so the LIVE word is not reachable there.
  • The tooltip vanishing (bug 6) and the axis and zone formats (bugs 1, 5) live in the chart engine shared with the Designer's trend dialog and canvas trend symbol; a fix reaches them too.

Not verified on the lab

  • The page without analytics.view (no loop field, From / To in a plain head): no such user; from code (TrendPage.tsx:180-182).
  • A live tail from MQTT and the LIVE word: no samples arrive on the lab since 7 Nov; from code.
  • The batch binding resolve is a POST; in every capture it was answered in the browser from one GET /api/bindings/resolve per path (the same answer), so the chart could draw. Nothing was sent or written.
  • "A pen not read" was simulated by aborting the OP history read in the browser (before-28).
  • Night theme seen once (before-31); keyboard use of the legend and zoom tools not checked; the Designer's link into Trend not opened.
  • The sample's chart lines are illustrative, drawn from the lab's ranges; the values, times, words and states are the lab's or the code's.
